title: Lower bound on the linear constraint optimum
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and let $P$ be an instance of the three-variable linear constraint problem over the field with two elements, with a nonempty multiset of constraints and every variable in $V$ occurring in some constraint scope. Then the maximum fraction of constraints satisfied by an assignment of field elements to $V$ is at least $1/2$.
